name: Notes and Events Hardening
required_scope: Strengthen debt, lease, covenant, receivable, bad-debt, supplier-finance, amendment, restatement, and subsequent-event handling.
Implement the controls in shared components rather than ticker-specific code or renderers.
contract_changes: Added notes_and_events_control_version to the shared Data and Evidence object and Gate 3 contract.
Added notes_and_events_assessment with all nine mandatory modules and statuses VALIDATED, MISSING, NOT_APPLICABLE, WARNING, or HARD_STOP.
Required note and event conclusions to resolve to stable evidence IDs and source URLs.
Kept the renderer as a consumer of validated output; it does not recalculate or repair note analysis.

requirement_acceptance.control: Separates carrying amounts, current/non-current classification, contractual maturities, facilities, and amendment or waiver signals.
Separates lease carrying values from undiscounted contractual payments and blocks false equivalence.
Distinguishes disclosed compliance, numerical headroom, revolver availability, waivers, and missing calculations.
Tracks gross or net receivables, allowance basis, period, and comparability without treating missing fields as zero.
Separates allowance methodology, provision, write-offs, and recoveries.
Requires an explicit basis for NOT_APPLICABLE; disclosure silence remains MISSING.
Searches filing indexes and disclosures for amendments, waivers, and relevant credit-agreement changes.
Classifies amended filings, restatement scope, and non-reliance events; material unresolved integrity issues can trigger HARD_STOP.
Classifies later filings and material 8-K events, preserves event dates, and prohibits silently mixing post-period events into historical balances.

tests_executed.suite: S07 dedicated positive and negative controls
complete unit and regression suite after S07

tests_executed.result: All nine modules returned explicit safe statuses and retained missing evidence instead of inventing values.

warnings: Keyword and filing-index detection identifies disclosure candidates but does not replace analyst review of legal agreements or footnotes.
MISSING and WARNING are intentional safe outcomes and must constrain downstream conclusions.
Live public filings are dated observations and may change after the run date.
unresolved_issues: A live amended or restated filing fixture and a live material subsequent-event fixture remain future coverage additions; the generic and synthetic control paths exist.
Convertible, preferred, distressed, and unusually complex capital structures remain outside the current shared non-financial issuer core.

exact_next_starting_point.first_action: Freeze CROX, AZO, and preserved unfamiliar company ODFL in one acceptance manifest, then run shared pipeline, safe-failure, Hard Stop rendering, and anti-hardcoding checks without changing S07 analytical files.
